description: NaSrCeBiO₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.96 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.55 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.54 Å) and four longer (3.00 Å) Sr-O bond lengths. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.55 Å) and four longer (2.99 Å) Sr-O bond lengths. Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 25°. All Ce-O bond lengths are 2.23 Å. Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 25°. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.14 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, one Ce, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, one Ce, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Sr, one Ce, and one Bi atom.
